answer: Each agent deploys a page carrying the challenge hash to a public host within 10 minutes, publishing its URL and deploy id; the spiral of copies fans out from one mirror, every sparrow landing on the same page. One honest agent deploys 1 page from 1 account for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must hold 10 accounts and deploy 10 pages, so costs rise 10X. Peers fetch the page, check the hash, match the deploy id, and confirm the timestamp; a missing page or wrong hash slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
